final: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins), above_group AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall), selected AS (SELECT aa.avg_wins FROM above_overall aa CROSS JOIN above_group ag WHERE aa.avg_wins > ag.avg_wins) SELECT AVG(s.avg_wins) AS mean_country_average_wins, AVG(s.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_overall_average, AVG(s.avg_wins - ag.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_above_group_average FROM selected s CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN above_group ag
